Question: Assalamwalikum, When i complete my bath (due to getting of wetness of my underwear,) or after urination or by seeing to girls, some drop falls (not semen.So in this case what i should do.Whether i have to change underwear or clean the drop of the same underwear.And if i clean the drop,again due to getting wetness drops fall.Pls reply me instantly. Answer ID: 6435 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 769/715=L/1429) If little wetness is discharged after urinating or because of bad thoughts or lusty look which does not cause slackness in the body, then if the clothes are smeared by it, you should wash them, since those drops are impure and the clothes will not be clean if the impurity was wiped with other clothes etc, it will remain impure. Also you should protect your eyes and keep yourself away from having bad look. Likewise, you should clean yourself with a clot or toilet paper after you urinate, and when the drops stop coming out, you should wash it with water and get into your clothes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
